facts.value: During this programme, you will examine the dynamics of leading learning and teaching by engaging with theories and practices of instructional leadership. You will build advanced knowledge of educational leadership through study of leadership approaches, case studies, and practical tools for leading change. You will examine the impact of national and international policy developments on the professional role of the teacher. You will foster inclusive and supportive leadership and explore strategies that promote equity, well-being, and collaborative and flourishing school cultures.
